PRINTERS.py.summary: This class models the Printers screen for HP Smart Android. It provides a structured Page Object Model (POM) with declarative locators and comprehensive method definitions. The class encapsulates all flows related to printer selection, searching, setup, and verification. It is designed for robust UI automation, including error handling and support for various Android versions and printer connection types.
